name: GitHub Notifications
author: Matteo Rosati
description: Unread GitHub notifications in the Omarchy bar. The GitHub mark is lit while `gh api notifications` has something for you and dimmed when the inbox is quiet; clicking it lists every notification with separate links to the repository and to the subject.

barWidget.description: Unread GitHub notifications via the gh CLI

schema.label: Subject link target
schema.description: api opens subject.url exactly as gh returns it (api.github.com). A browser fetches that unauthenticated, so it is charged to GitHub's 60-requests-per-hour budget per IP address and shows raw JSON (404 for a private repository). web rewrites it to the matching github.com page and costs no API request at all.
